name: azclaude-copilot
description: AI coding environment — 40 commands, 10 skills, 15 agents, real-time visualizer, memory, reflexes, evolution. Install: npx azclaude-copilot@latest, then open Claude Code.

scripts.postversion: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version;const fs=require('fs');for(const f of['.claude-plugin/plugin.json','.claude-plugin/marketplace.json']){const j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'));if(f.includes('marketplace')){j.plugins[0].version=v}else{j.version=v}fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(j,null,2)+'\n')};console.log('Synced plugin files to v'+v)"

author: haytamAroui
